🤝 Provider Platform

# List your API
on Pylon.

Reach every agent in the x402 ecosystem. You build the API — we handle payments, distribution, and discovery. Get paid in USDC on Base.

Why List on Pylon

## You build the API. We handle everything else.

### Instant x402 Payments

You don't implement crypto. Pylon handles x402 payment negotiation, verification, and settlement. You just serve HTTP responses.

### Agent Distribution

Your API is instantly discoverable by every x402-compatible agent. No marketing, no sales, no integrations to build.

### MCP Auto-Listing

Your API automatically appears in Pylon's MCP configuration — compatible with Claude, Cursor, and every MCP client.

### Usage Analytics

Track requests, revenue, and usage patterns. See which agents are using your API and how.

How It Works

## Four steps to revenue

1

### Submit Your API

Tell us your endpoint, parameters, and pricing. We review it for quality and reliability.

2

### We Approve

Your API is added to the Pylon registry. Agents can discover it immediately.

3

### Agents Pay & Use

Agents discover your API via the gateway and pay per request in USDC.

4

### You Get Paid

You receive 85% of revenue in USDC on Base. Pylon takes a 15% platform fee.

Revenue

## Keep 85% of every request

Pylon platform fee
